Parking the whole roadmap. This supersedes my open question about promoting O2, so nothing is promoted and no stage is handed off.

**What parks.** There are four deferred items, one per unticked stage and one per Ranked-list item:

| Item | From | Done when |
|---|---|---|
| Closure notices | Stage 2 (Track B) | the notice job and its operator mailing list exist |
| 7-day closure-risk outlook | Track A Ranked list, O2 | a 7-day closure-risk outlook for each lock from the river-level forecast |
| Per-lock closure curves, pooled | Track A Ranked list, O3 | separate closure curves for all 14 locks, pooled across locks |
| Closure-history map | Track A Ranked list, O4 | a closure-history map for the canal's boat operators |

Text-message notices don't get an item, because Stage 2's `Leaves out` already said nothing picks them up. Stage 1's findings file stays where it is, since it is a shipped result and not roadmap scaffolding. There is no synthesized spec, methodology or critique file to retire, because the roadmap's Source is your own words.

**Steps.** I'll run these when tools are back:

1. Read the writing-plans deferred-backlog reference for the Deferred-item schema. Then read `specs/deferred_items.md`, if it exists, so I append to it and don't overwrite it.
2. Append the four items under `## lock-closures-roadmap — <date>`. Each item will be self-contained, with a `Size:` drawn from its cost note and a `Done when:` as in the table above. For example, O2's size is small once a model like Stage 1's exists, since that fit took 22 minutes on 1.8 GB. O3 is about 14 times Stage 1's data.
3. Mark the roadmap `PARKED (<date>) — 1 of 2 stages complete` and move it:
   `git mv specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md`
4. Commit on `main`:
   `git commit -m "Park lock-closures roadmap: funding ended; 1 of 2 stages complete"`

**One thing to confirm: the date.** The session says today is 2026-11-06, but my environment reports 2026-11-27. I'll stamp the section heading and the PARKED line with **2026-11-06** unless you tell me otherwise.
